items.title: 川習會還沒登場就先失去優勢？川普疏遠盟友讓中國得利
paras: 美國總統川普周三(23日)迎接中國國家主席習近平，展開為期兩天的會談，正式峰會將於周四(24日)登場。川普多年來透過關稅、先進科技管制及盟友合作施壓北京，但這次面對的中國不僅更難被孤立，還握有稀土等足以反制美國的關鍵籌碼。更棘手的是，川普重返白宮後與傳統盟友衝突不斷，使華府愈來愈難組成共同對中陣線。
從全球貿易與稀土供應，到台灣軍售及伊朗戰爭，這場川習會將檢驗美國在盟友漸行漸遠之際，還剩下多少迫使北京讓步的能力。

川普疏遠傳統盟友 美國最大優勢遭削弱

數十年來，美國相較中國最大的結構性優勢，就是遍布歐洲及亞洲的盟友與夥伴網絡。當華府限制中國取得科技或祭出制裁時，若歐洲與亞洲主要經濟體同步配合，北京規避限制的難度便會大幅提高。
中國至今仍缺乏可與美國相比的同盟體系。澳洲智庫Lowy Institute數據顯示，2025年美國防務網絡評分達81.4分，中國僅18.9分。然而，北京不必說服美國盟友倒向中國，只要讓這些國家不再願意跟隨華府行動，就足以侵蝕美國優勢。
布魯金斯學會中國中心主任哈斯(Ryan Hass)表示，中國正試圖把自己塑造成一個穩定力量，與「反覆無常且訴諸暴力的美國」形成對比。他指出，美國在世界舞台上仍擁有無可匹敵的力量，但要把力量轉化為談判籌碼，必須建立統一陣線，如今願意追隨美國的國家卻愈來愈少。
川普近來與北約盟國因國防支出發生衝突，揚言削減美國在歐洲多地的駐軍，又在威脅接管格陵蘭後宣布增派部隊，並對加拿大加徵關稅。大西洋理事會全球中國中心資深主任哈特(Melanie Hart)指出，美國的盟友雖然普遍認同華府對中國經濟模式的擔憂，但川普政府選擇同時攻擊這些國家，而非組成共同陣線。
盟友對美國的信任也明顯下降。皮尤研究中心(Pew Research Center)6月調查顯示，加拿大民眾認為美國是可靠夥伴的比例，從2022年的83%降至今年的35%；德國民眾認為華府制定外交政策時會考慮其他國家利益的比例，也從2023年的60%降至23%。
加拿大本月更獲邀成為歐盟首個「準會員」，反映加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)政府正尋求深化與歐洲的防務關係，並降低對美國的依賴。哈特表示，美國盟友擔心，即使與華府達成協議，之後仍可能遭到川普政府削弱或推翻。

中國握有稀土籌碼 美國則以晶片管制反制

中國正利用這道裂痕，讓各國不必在北京與華府之間二選一。印度仍是美國安全夥伴，也是中國的戰略競爭對手，雙方軍隊至今仍部署於存在爭議的喜馬拉雅邊界。但習近平本月睽違7年再度訪問印度，兩國開始採取穩定關係的「小步驟」。
根據中國數據，中印2025年雙邊貿易額創下1,556億美元新高。習近平與印度總理莫迪(Narendra Modi)也同意加強商業及交通聯繫，儘管雙方安全爭端仍未解決。專家指出，川普對中政策的不確定性，加上美印關係承壓，都讓印度更有理由避免與中國關係惡化。
中國也持續深化與全球其他地區的貿易關係。即使對美出口下滑，中國2025年全球貿易順差仍創下1.2兆美元紀錄，並可能連續第二年突破1兆美元。
美中籌碼變化在經濟領域尤其明顯。川普利用關稅打擊中國對美國市場的依賴，又透過出口管制限制北京取得先進晶片及半導體製造設備。中國則利用稀土反制，去年將7種稀土元素納入出口管制，要求企業取得政府許可才能出口。
美國地質調查所數據顯示，中國2024年控制全球約70%的稀土開採，以及超過87%的精煉與生產。管制實施後，福特(F-US)一度因磁鐵短缺，暫停芝加哥工廠的Explorer休旅車生產一周，日本及歐洲汽車零件商也曾因等待原料被迫關閉生產線。
美國因而嘗到自己多年來試圖施加給中國的處境：依賴一項可能遭對方切斷的關鍵資源。當前美中貿易休戰將於11月10日到期，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與中國國務院副總理何立峰上周末會談時，稀土再度成為談判焦點。
不過，川普仍有牌可打。美國及盟國企業掌握先進半導體供應鏈的關鍵環節，美方限制依然妨礙中國取得最尖端晶片及製造設備。川普政府在維持廣泛限制的同時，允許輝達(NVDA-US)向中國有限度出售H200 AI晶片，也讓半導體供應成為另一項談判籌碼。

台灣軍售與伊朗戰爭成峰會兩大考題

美中討價還價的範圍也開始超越貿易。價值140億美元的對台軍售案已等待川普批准數月。川普5月與習近平會面後表示，已暫緩處理這筆軍售，並形容它是一項「非常好的談判籌碼」。
北京視台灣為中國領土，也從未放棄以武力實現統一，習近平5月會晤川普時再次就美國對台軍售施壓。軍售案延宕，已引發美國亞洲盟友擔憂，川普可能以弱化華府對台支持，換取習近平在經貿問題上讓步。
哈特認為，北京的真正目標不只是一筆軍售，而是讓川普相信自己正與習近平推進一項重大協議，進而主動約束美國對台支持。她指出，從140億美元軍售案遭到擱置來看，中方顯然已取得部分進展。
伊朗問題則是反向考驗，即中國能否把華府缺乏的外交關係轉化為地緣政治影響力。美國數十年來試圖孤立德黑蘭，北京卻持續維持經貿與外交往來，並頻繁購買伊朗原油。習近平也曾表示願意協助調停美伊戰爭。
但目前美國與伊朗似乎都無意立即尋求停戰，使北京短期內能發揮的作用有限。哈斯表示，川普不習慣透過國際聯盟處理問題，而是傾向直接運用國家力量。這場川習會因此不只是兩位領袖的談判，也將證明在傳統盟友不再願意無條件配合後，美國單打獨鬥還剩多少對中籌碼。

items.title: 上周升息還不夠！Fed理事巴爾暗示至少再升兩次
items.title_en: Last Week's Rate Hike Not Enough! Fed Governor Barr Hints at At Least Two More Increases
paras: 聯準會(Fed)理事巴爾(Michael Barr)周三(23日)表示，美國通膨風險升高、勞動市場風險則已減退，Fed上周升息只是重新調整貨幣政策的重要一步，未來可能還需要進一步升息，才能讓通膨及時回到2%目標。
巴爾在芝加哥Fed住房負擔能力會議的預備講稿中指出，美國經濟成長強勁、勞動市場依然穩健，但通膨仍高於Fed的2%目標，也未明確朝目標水準下降。他說，在其基本預測情境下，可能還需進一步調整政策，確保通膨及時降至目標。
Fed上周全員一致決議升息1碼，將政策利率調高至3.75%至4.00%；18名官員中有16人預估，今年底前至少還需升息一次。巴爾使用複數的「進一步政策調整」，暗示他可能認為至少還要升息兩次，但並未說明時間表。
巴爾表示，Fed先前的政策立場已不再符合經濟情勢，上周升息是朝正確方向修正。他認為，物價穩定是實現充分就業及支持經濟持續、穩健成長的關鍵。這番明確表態，也與Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)拒絕提供未來利率路徑指引形成對比。
巴爾指出，過去一年半來，美國經濟接連遭遇關稅、中東衝突、俄烏戰爭造成的供應中斷，以及AI基礎建設投資激增等衝擊，持續帶來物價上漲壓力。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場預估Fed在10月會議升息的機率約為55%，遠高於一個月前的9%。
巴爾演說大部分內容聚焦住房負擔能力。他表示，房屋供應不足及房貸利率居高不下，使購屋壓力進一步惡化。美國30年期固定房貸平均利率上周升至7.12%，創逾兩年新高。
paras_en: Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday (the 23rd) that while inflation risks in the United States have risen, labor‑market risks have eased, and last week’s rate hike was only an important step in readjusting monetary policy. Further hikes may be needed to bring inflation back to the 2% target in a timely manner.

In a preparatory speech for the Chicago Fed’s housing‑affordability meeting, Barr noted that the U.S. economy is growing strongly and the labor market remains robust, but inflation stays above the Fed’s 2% goal and has not shown a clear decline toward that level. He said that under his baseline outlook, additional policy adjustments may be required to ensure inflation falls to target on schedule.

The Fed voted unanimously last week to raise the policy rate by one quarter point, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%; of the 18 officials, 16 project at least one more hike before year‑end. By referring to “further policy adjustments” in the plural, Barr signaled he may think at least two more hikes are needed, though he gave no timetable.

Barr said the Fed’s earlier policy stance no longer fits the economic situation and that last week’s hike was a correction in the right direction. He argued that price stability is key to achieving full employment and supporting sustained, solid growth. This clear stance contrasts with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s refusal to provide forward guidance on the rate path.

Barr pointed out that over the past 18 months the U.S. economy has faced a series of shocks – tariffs, Middle‑East conflicts, supply disruptions from the Russia‑Ukraine war, and a surge in AI‑related infrastructure investment – all keeping price pressures high. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees about a 55% chance of a rate hike at the October meeting, up sharply from 9% a month earlier.

Most of Barr’s remarks focused on housing affordability. He said that a shortage of homes and persistently high mortgage rates are worsening home‑buying pressure. The average rate on a 30‑year fixed mortgage rose to 7.12% last week, a new high not seen in over two years.

items.title: 殖利率曲線倒掛警鈴大作！Fed升息預期再起 華爾街點名兩大類股最受傷
items.title_en: Yield Curve Inversion Alarm Bells Ring! Fed Rate Hike Expectations Resurge, Wall Street Names Two Sectors Most Hurt
paras: 由於油價飆升、華爾街開始準備聯準會(Fed)升息以壓制通膨，反映短期和長期公債殖利率利差的美國公債殖利率曲線，自伊朗戰爭爆發以來大幅趨平並走向倒掛。殖利率曲線倒掛過去一直是美股與美國經濟即將有麻煩的警訊，但其可靠程度現在卻被打上問號。
2年期美債殖利率目前僅比10年期低約22個基點(0.22個百分點)，遠低於2月接近75個基點的差距，隨著兩者逐漸靠攏，2年期超越10年期的殖利率曲線「倒掛」，愈來愈有可能發生。
殖利率曲線倒掛被視為具有預測經濟衰退的能力，因其往往比衰退更早出現。此外，殖利率曲線倒掛這也可能傷害市場部分類股，尤其是金融股。
Janney Montgomery Scott固定收益首席策略師Guy LeBas周二(22日)預測，殖利率曲線可能倒掛，當長短債殖利率之間的利差縮小到這種程度後，很少會長期維持在這個水準，通常會擴大至約50個基點，或縮小至零。
LeBas補充說：「我認為(利差縮小到)零，比較可能發生。」

衰退風險正在升高？

過去約七個月來，殖利率曲線持續趨平，原因是油價大幅上漲助長通膨升溫疑慮，交易員預期Fed將啟動2020年以來第二個升息循環，導致對政策利率敏感的2年期美債殖利率不斷上升。
美國殖利率曲線出現倒掛之後，經濟衰退通常在一年後發生。但根據克里夫蘭聯準銀行研究人員的說法，過去也曾出現「三次值得注意的假陽性」：分別是1966年年底、1998年年底「非常平坦的殖利率曲線」，以及2022年年底至2024年年底的倒掛。
然而，即使只是轉向殖利率曲線更加趨平的環境，也可能帶來負面影響。銀行在一些基本業務上的獲利空間可能縮小，例如向客戶提供較長期貸款所賺取的收入，相較於支付給客戶短期存款的利息可能減少。
根據FactSet，標普500指數金融股周二下挫1.8%，今年來累積漲幅幾乎被抹去。公用事業通常也屬於資本密集型產業，而標普500公用事業類股今年到周二為止共下跌4.8%。
這顯示市場對這一輪升息循環可能達到的幅度感到不安，同時也凸顯出，即使標普500指數與那斯達克綜合指數目前都接近歷史高點，亮麗表現卻隱藏了脆弱之處。
Fed上周啟動三年來首次升息，將基準利率調升至3.75-4.00%。2年期美債殖利率周二維持在約4.76%，顯示市場預期還會有更多升息。
高盛(Goldman Sachs)首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius周二表示，他預期Fed將在五周後的10月決策會議上再次升息，原因是伊朗戰爭升溫、油價上漲以及隨後出現的煉油廠瓶頸，而且美國經濟成長與通膨也高於預期。
Janney的LeBas預期，Fed整體將升息75個基點，幅度足以抵銷2025年的「保險性」降息。他表示，在能源價格走高的情況下升息通常並非「好的策略」，但人工智慧(AI)支出熱潮仍為經濟及股市帶來大量正向外溢效應。
LeBas表示：「你不需要再看其他地方，只要看看股市的反應，就能知道5%的10年期美債殖利率對風險資產有多麼微不足道。」他表示，科技投資熱潮「終有一天會消退」，「只不過不是今天」。
10年期美債殖利率上周觸及5%，這個關鍵整數價位過去曾被成為股市的阻力，但目前為止似乎無礙股市漲勢。該殖利率過去幾個月以來大致跟隨油價上下波動，目前持續在5%附近徘徊。
高盛大宗商品策略師預期，布蘭特原油價格可望從周二約每桶100美元的水準，到12月逐步回落至每桶85美元，這將讓Fed有更多喘息空間。
與此同時，富國投資研究所(Wells Fargo Investment Institute)全球投資策略主管Paul Christopher表示，經濟「仍然健康，而且已證明可以承受較高的利率與通膨」。
他說：「我們看好今年標普500指數能登上7800至8000點。」並認為殖利率曲線不會完全趨平，也不會倒掛。

指標仍顯示衰退機率低

克里夫蘭聯準銀行研究殖利率曲線指標的研究人員指出，過去九次美國衰退之前都曾出現殖利率曲線倒掛，包括最近一次在2020年3月的衰退。
他們的指標聚焦於3個月期的美國國庫券殖利率、與10年期美債殖利率之間的利差。該指標在8月公布的最近期讀數顯示，未來一年內發生衰退的機率僅12.3%。
paras_en: Because oil prices have surged and Wall Street is beginning to brace for Federal Reserve rate hikes to curb inflation, the U.S. Treasury yield curve—reflecting the spread between short‑term and long‑term bond yields—has flattened dramatically and moved into inversion for the first time since the Iran war began. Historically, an inverted yield curve has been a warning sign that U.S. stocks and the economy are headed for trouble, but its reliability is now being questioned.

The 2‑year Treasury yield is currently only about 22 basis points (0.22 percentage points) lower than the 10‑year yield, far below the roughly 75‑basis‑point gap seen in February. As the two yields converge, a 2‑year‑over‑10‑year inversion becomes increasingly likely.
An inverted yield curve is viewed as a predictor of recession because it usually appears well before a downturn. It can also hurt certain market sectors, especially financial stocks.

Janney Montgomery Scott fixed‑income chief strategist Guy LeBas said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that the yield curve may invert; once the spread between short‑ and long‑term yields narrows to this level, it rarely stays there for long, typically expanding back to about 50 basis points or shrinking to zero.
LeBas added, “I think a spread narrowing to zero is the more likely outcome.”

Recession risk is rising? Over the past roughly seven months the yield curve has been flattening as sharply higher oil prices have stoked inflation concerns, leading traders to expect the Fed to start its second rate‑hiking cycle since 2020, which has pushed the policy‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield higher.

After the U.S. yield curve inverts, recessions usually occur about a year later. However, Cleveland Federal Reserve researchers note three notable false‑positives in the past: a very flat curve at the end of 1966, another at the end of 1998, and the 2022‑2024 inversion period.

Even a shift toward a flatter curve can have negative effects. Banks’ profit margins on core activities may shrink, such as the earnings from offering longer‑term loans versus the interest they pay on short‑term deposits.

According to FactSet, S&P 500 financial stocks fell 1.8% on Tuesday, erasing almost all of their year‑to‑date gains. Utilities, also capital‑intensive, have dropped 4.8% in the S&P 500 up to Tuesday this year.

This shows market unease about how far this rate‑hiking cycle may go and highlights that, even though the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are near historic highs, their strong performance masks underlying fragility.

The Fed last week initiated its first rate hike in three years, raising the target range to 3.75‑4.00%. The 2‑year Treasury yield held around 4.76% on Tuesday, indicating expectations of further hikes.

Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius said on Tuesday he expects the Fed to raise rates again at its October meeting, five weeks away, due to the escalating Iran conflict, higher oil prices, emerging refinery bottlenecks, and U.S. growth and inflation running above forecasts.

LeBas of Janney projects the Fed will lift rates by a total of 75 basis points, enough to offset any “insurance‑type” rate cuts slated for 2025. He noted that raising rates amid rising energy prices is usually not a “good strategy,” but the AI spending boom continues to generate strong positive spillovers for the economy and equity markets.

LeBas said, “You don’t need to look anywhere else—just watch the market’s reaction to see how trivial a 5% 10‑year Treasury yield is for risk assets.” He added that the tech investment frenzy will eventually fade, “just not today.”

The 10‑year Treasury yield hit 5% last week, a round number that has historically acted as resistance for equities, yet so far it has not stalled the market’s rally. The yield has been tracking oil price movements over recent months and is now hovering near 5%.
Goldman Sachs commodity strategists expect Brent crude to fall from about $100 a barrel on Tuesday to around $85 by December, giving the Fed more breathing room.
Meanwhile, Paul Christopher, global investment strategy head at Wells Fargo Investment Institute, said the economy “remains healthy and has proven it can withstand higher rates and inflation.”
He added, “We are bullish that the S&P 500 can reach 7,800‑8,000 this year,” and believes the yield curve will neither flatten completely nor invert.

Recession probability remains low. Researchers at the Cleveland Federal Reserve who track the yield‑curve indicator note that an inverted curve preceded each of the nine U.S. recessions in the past, including the most recent one in March 2020.

Their metric focuses on the spread between the 3‑month Treasury bill yield and the 10‑year Treasury yield. The latest reading released in August showed a 12.3% probability of a recession occurring within the next year.

items.title: Netflix砸大錢來搶人！YouTube祭出AI新武器守住創作者
items.title_en: Netflix Throws Money at Creators! YouTube Deploys New AI Tools to Keep Creators
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下YouTube靠著數位創作者崛起，成為全球最大影音平台，如今卻面臨Netflix(NFLX-US)進攻其深耕20年的核心市場，以優渥合約爭搶頂尖創作者。為鞏固創作者忠誠度並留住更多獨家內容，YouTube周三宣布推出一系列新工具，涵蓋微短劇、AI剪輯、影片測試及直播即時配音，全面迎戰Netflix的挖角攻勢。

Netflix砸錢搶創作者 YouTube靠分潤與廣告資源迎戰

據《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周三(23日)報導，以《怪奇物語》和《Kpop獵魔女團》等熱門作品聞名的Netflix，正開出高額合約，吸引《Good Mythical Morning》、《Alan’s Universe》等YouTube熱門節目製作團隊，將Netflix打造為YouTube之外的「第二個家」。
Netflix最初從兒童內容切入，陸續引進《Ms.Rachel》、《馬克羅伯：CrunchLabs》和《Danny Go!》，如今這些節目已成為平台最受兒童歡迎的內容。Netflix接著進軍同樣由YouTube主導的影音Podcast市場，開始招攬面向成人觀眾的熱門節目。
相關合約通常涵蓋全球市場，允許創作者同時與Netflix和YouTube合作，但不得把內容提供給其他串流平台。由於多數創作者仍仰賴YouTube建立擁有數百萬名訂閱者的頻道，完全離開並不實際，因此Netflix多半要求跨平台發布，或在原有YouTube作品之外製作額外內容。
Netflix積極搶人，背後也有提高用戶觀看時間的壓力。尼爾森(Nielsen)數據顯示，YouTube今年7月占美國電視串流觀看時間14.2%，幾乎是排名第二的Netflix兩倍。相較《柏捷頓家族：名門韻事》等高成本製作，數位創作者節目能以少得多的成本帶來更多觀看。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與迪士尼(DIS-US)也開始和創作者合作，但行動都不如Netflix積極。
YouTube執行長莫漢(Neal Mohan)面臨的難題是，YouTube主要透過廣告分潤吸引創作者，而非預先支付大筆製作費。創作者通常可取得影片廣告收入的55%。對於考慮與Netflix簽約的創作者，YouTube也曾提醒，跨平台發布可能影響品牌合作，或減少他們在年度Brandcast等廣告活動中的曝光機會。

微短劇、AI剪輯與即時配音成留人武器

在本周舉行的Made on YouTube大會上，YouTube公布多項創作工具。觀眾未來可依照當下心情建立個人化推薦演算法，例如只想看喜劇時，便不會收到政治評論影片。
針對娛樂市場熱門的微短劇，YouTube Shorts創作者將可製作連續播放的單元式系列影片，強化短影音的追劇體驗。平台還將推出AI敘事助理，根據頻道過去哪些內容有效、哪些效果不佳，分析劇本與影片粗剪，協助創作者調整作品。
另一項工具可讓創作者發布不同剪輯版本進行A/B測試，再撤下表現較差的版本。直播創作者則可啟用從英文即時配音為西班牙文的AI功能，作為未來擴大支援更多語言的第一步。莫漢表示，語言可能是創作者接觸新觀眾的最後一道障礙，而即時翻譯有望將其消除。
不過，與Netflix合作對創作者在YouTube的觀看表現影響不一。Tubular Labs資料顯示，部分頻道觀看次數下降，也有一些反而上升。YouTube合作事務副總裁卡茲(Tim Katz)表示，公司正密切追蹤相關趨勢，協助創作者了解跨平台策略可能帶來的影響。隨著創作者在媒體與廣告市場的重要性提高，YouTube與Netflix的競爭也從搶奪觀眾注意力，進一步延伸至頂尖內容人才。
paras_en: Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) YouTube, which rose on the back of digital creators to become the world’s largest video platform, now faces an attack from Netflix (NFLX-US) on its core market that it has cultivated for 20 years, offering lucrative contracts to poach top creators. To cement creator loyalty and retain more exclusive content, YouTube announced on Wednesday a suite of new tools covering micro‑dramas, AI editing, video testing and live‑stream real‑time dubbing, aimed at countering Netflix’s poaching offensive.

According to the Wall Street Journal on Wednesday (the 23rd), Netflix—known for hits such as “Stranger Things” and “K‑Pop Witch Hunt”—is rolling out high‑value contracts to lure popular YouTube shows like “Good Mythical Morning” and “Alan’s Universe,” positioning Netflix as a “second home” for creators beyond YouTube.

Netflix initially entered the market with children’s content, later adding shows such as “Ms. Rachel,” “Markrober: CrunchLabs,” and “Danny Go!,” which have become some of the platform’s most‑watched kids’ titles. It is now moving into the video‑podcast space, also dominated by YouTube, by courting popular adult‑oriented programs.

The deals typically cover worldwide rights and allow creators to work with both Netflix and YouTube, but prohibit distributing the same content to other streaming services. Because most creators still rely on YouTube to build channels with millions of subscribers, a full exit is impractical, so Netflix usually asks for cross‑platform releases or for additional content separate from existing YouTube videos.

Netflix’s aggressive talent hunt is driven by a need to boost viewer hours. Nielsen data shows YouTube captured 14.2% of U.S. TV‑streaming minutes in July, almost twice Netflix’s share, which ranks second. Compared with high‑budget productions like “The Bachelorette Family: Noble Affairs,” creator‑driven shows cost far less while delivering more watch time. Amazon (AMZN-US) and Disney (DIS-US) have also begun working with creators, but their efforts lag behind Netflix’s pace.

YouTube CEO Neal Mohan faces the challenge that YouTube mainly attracts creators through ad‑revenue sharing rather than upfront production fees. Creators typically receive 55% of ad revenue. For those considering Netflix deals, YouTube has warned that cross‑platform publishing could affect brand partnerships or reduce exposure in annual Brandcast advertising events.

At this week’s Made on YouTube conference, YouTube unveiled several creation tools. Viewers will soon be able to set personalized recommendation algorithms based on mood—for example, opting to see only comedy and not political commentary.

For the popular micro‑drama format, Shorts creators will be able to produce episodic series that play back‑to‑back, enhancing the binge‑watch experience for short‑form video. The platform will also launch an AI narrative assistant that analyzes past channel performance, evaluates scripts and rough cuts, and helps creators refine their content.

Another tool lets creators upload multiple edited versions for A/B testing and automatically retire the underperforming version. Live‑stream creators can enable an AI feature that provides real‑time English‑to‑Spanish dubbing, a first step toward supporting more languages. Mohan said language may be the last barrier to reaching new audiences, and real‑time translation could eliminate it.

However, the impact of Netflix collaborations on YouTube performance varies. Tubular Labs data shows some channels see view counts dip while others rise. YouTube’s Vice President of Partnerships Tim Katz said the company is closely monitoring trends to help creators understand the effects of cross‑platform strategies. As creators become more important in the media and advertising ecosystem, the competition between YouTube and Netflix is expanding from audience attention to the battle for top‑tier talent.

items.title: SpaceX上市後首次！總裁擬減持34萬股 套現5,200萬美元
items.title_en: SpaceX’s First Post‑IPO Sale: President Plans to Offload 342,170 Shares, Cashing Out $52 Million
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 上市後迎來首個高層減持信號，總裁兼營運長格溫·肖特維爾（Gwynne Shotwell）擬出售逾5,200萬美元股票，時間節點恰在星艦首次入軌測試前夕，令市場對SpaceX高估值的分歧再度浮上檯面。
監管文件顯示，肖特維爾擬出售342,170股，合計市值約5,196萬美元，相關股份通過現金行權股票期權方式取得。
肖特維爾此次減持並非臨時起意。SpaceX在上市後首份季報中揭露，她已於6月23日採納一項10b5-1交易計畫，覆蓋至多585,605股。
此次出售通知所列股份數量未超出該計畫揭露上限，SpaceX亦表明其大部分持股仍處於延長鎖定期內。
10b5-1計畫是美國證券法框架下允許公司內部人士預先設定股票交易安排的合規工具，旨在將交易與內部消息獲取在時間上隔離，從而規避內線交易指控。
由於該計畫早於星艦測試窗口確定之前便已採納，從法律層面看，此次減持具備明確合規依據。
然而，分析人士指出，合規性與市場觀感之間存在落差。在SpaceX估值高、星艦商業化前景尚存不確定性的背景下，高層減持往往會被市場解讀為對短期股價的隱性判斷。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX‑US) has seen its first senior‑executive sell‑off signal since going public, as President and COO Gwynne Shotwell intends to sell more than $52 million worth of stock, timing the sale just before the first orbital test flight of Starship, reigniting market debate over SpaceX’s lofty valuation.
Regulatory filings show Shotwell plans to sell 342,170 shares, valued at roughly $51.96 million, with the shares to be acquired through cash‑settled stock options.
This divestiture is not a spur‑of‑the‑moment decision. In SpaceX’s first quarterly report after the IPO, it disclosed that she adopted a 10b5‑1 trading plan on June 23 covering up to 585,605 shares.
The number of shares listed in the sale notice does not exceed the limit disclosed in that plan, and SpaceX also indicated that most of her holdings remain under an extended lock‑up period.

A 10b5‑1 plan is a compliance tool under U.S. securities law that allows insiders to pre‑set stock‑trade arrangements, separating the timing of transactions from the receipt of material non‑public information to avoid insider‑trading accusations.
Because the plan was adopted before the Starship test window was set, the sale has a clear legal basis from a compliance standpoint.

Nevertheless, analysts note a gap between compliance and market perception. Given SpaceX’s high valuation and the still‑uncertain commercial prospects of Starship, senior‑executive sell‑offs are often read by the market as an implicit short‑term price judgment.

items.title: 川普才喊「徹底摧毀」！伊朗總統聯合國強硬反擊：我們才是恐怖主義受害者
items.title_en: Trump Calls for ‘Total Destruction’, Iran’s President Fires Back at the UN: ‘We Are the Victims of Terrorism’
paras: 伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)周三(23日)在紐約聯合國大會發表強硬演說，指控美國與以色列加劇全球局勢動盪，並對伊朗平民及基礎設施發動非法攻擊。他更宣示，伊朗將持續反擊，「直到我們嚥下最後一口氣」。
裴澤斯基安致詞一開始便高舉多張兒童照片，稱照片中的孩子均死於美國及以色列的轟炸，藉此控訴兩國軍事行動造成平民傷亡，並將伊朗描述為美以侵略行動下的受害者。
這場演說也直接回應美國總統川普前一天在聯合國的發言。美伊戰爭延燒近7個月之際，川普表示，正考慮是否要「徹底摧毀」伊朗。
裴澤斯基安反駁稱：「美國總統將我們形容為恐怖分子，但我們才是恐怖主義的受害者。」他接著質問：「難道我們才是動盪的根源嗎？我們只是希望獨立自主地生活。犯下恐怖主義行徑與罪行的人，反而成了和平與穩定的捍衛者嗎？」
裴澤斯基安的強硬立場，也與川普一再宣稱伊朗迫切尋求和平協議、雙方可能在11月3日期中選舉後迅速達成協議的說法形成鮮明對比。整場演說未見德黑蘭釋出退讓訊號，反而顯示伊朗仍準備將戰事延續下去。
川普周三並未留在聯合國現場，他已於前一晚返回華府，準備迎接赴美進行國是訪問的中國國家主席習近平。
《紐約時報》(NYT)指出，裴澤斯基安此次現身具有歷史意義，過去從未有任何國家領袖在本國正與美國交戰期間，親自赴聯合國大會發表演說。
paras_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian delivered a hard‑line speech at the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Wednesday (the 23rd), accusing the United States and Israel of worsening global instability and launching illegal attacks on Iranian civilians and infrastructure. He declared that Iran will continue to fight back “until we take our last breath.”

Peze​shkian began his remarks by holding up several photographs of children, saying the kids in the pictures were killed by U.S. and Israeli bombings, thereby condemning the two countries’ military actions for causing civilian casualties and portraying Iran as a victim of U.S.–Israeli aggression.

The speech was a direct response to U.S. President Donald Trump’s remarks at the United Nations the day before. With the Iran‑U.S. war dragging on for nearly seven months, Trump said he was considering whether to “totally destroy” Iran.

Peze​shkian retorted: “The U.S. president calls us terrorists, but we are the victims of terrorism.” He then asked, “Are we the source of the turmoil? All we want is to live independently. Those who commit terrorist acts and crimes become the defenders of peace and stability?”

Peze​shkian’s hard‑line stance also starkly contrasts with Trump’s repeated claims that Iran is eager for a peace deal and that the two sides could quickly reach an agreement after the November 3 presidential election. The speech gave no sign of Tehran conceding and instead showed Iran remains prepared to prolong the conflict.
Trump was not present at the UN on Wednesday; he had returned to Washington the night before to prepare for the upcoming state visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to the United States.

The New York Times noted that Peze​shkian’s appearance was historically significant, as no national leader had ever spoken at a UN General Assembly session while his country was at war with the United States.

items.title: 短期爆紅還是Meta的「ChatGPT時刻」？ 小摩：Muse有望成ChatGPT後最廣泛使用AI應用程式
items.title_en: Short‑Lived Hype or Meta’s “ChatGPT Moment”? JPMorgan: Muse Could Become the Most Widely Used AI App Since ChatGPT
paras: 上線僅兩週，Meta旗下個人AI代理Muse已衝上美國蘋果App Store免費榜榜首，成為近期科技與資本市場焦點。根據Sensor Tower數據顯示，自9月8日發布以來，Muse下載量突破250萬次，內部數據更顯示上線約一週實際使用人數超過50萬，日活躍用戶逾25萬，累計提交指令超過200萬條。
摩根大通(下稱小摩)周二(22日)發布研報指出，Muse正在展現出強勁的早期用戶成長，並可能成為公司將AI投入從「廣告提效」進一步轉化為廣告之外新收入來源的重要入口。小摩認為，隨著消費者和企業逐步擁有自己的AI智能體，未來購物、預訂和服務交易可能越來越多透過「智能體對智能體」完成，為Meta打開廣告之外的新商業模式。因此，小摩重申Meta「增持」評等和820美元目標價。
《The Information》報導，受Muse獲大量正面評價激勵，Meta股價週一(21日)大漲11%，創去年4月以來最大漲幅，9月迄今漲近30%，這個上線不到半個月的AI應用，同時撬動用戶增長、估值預期與多產業競爭敘事，讓外界好奇這究竟是短期爆紅，還是Meta真正的「ChatGPT時刻」？
Muse的核心差異在於將AI從「回答問題」推向「替你辦事」。用戶可指令它查詢與預訂旅行、尋找優惠、撥打電話、發送郵件、填寫網頁表格、整理收件箱及處理日程衝突。它還能連接Gmail、蘋果與谷歌日曆、OpenTable等服務，並結合Facebook Marketplace、Instagram等Meta生態資訊執行個人化任務。
相較2022年底ChatGPT首次讓大眾感受生成式AI價值，Muse試圖完成下一步轉化，讓過去主要由開發者使用的AI Agent進入普通消費者日常生活，而早期數據支持這種可能性。在可比較的發布週期裡，Muse美國累計下載量一度超越ChatGPT、Claude與Grok。
摩根大通分析師Doug Anmuth認為，Muse有潛力成為ChatGPT之後使用最廣泛的消費級AI應用之一。Meta更擁有獨立AI創業公司難以複製的優勢：臉書、Instagram與WhatsApp涵蓋數十億用戶，Muse除獨立App外也已嵌入WhatsApp。AI代理越深入郵件、日曆、聯絡人與消費數據，個人化價值越高，而Meta早已掌握龐大用戶關係與內容數據。
Muse影響力已開始溢出AI領域。在與PayPal、Plaid等企業合作後，標普500金融族群周二(22日)下跌2%，嘉信理財與LPL Financial跌幅更超過6%，摩根大通、美國銀行等大型銀行亦明顯下挫。市場擔憂，若AI代理能全天候協助用戶轉移資金、管理閒置現金、執行稅務策略與比較金融產品，部分依賴客戶慣性、閒置資金與人工服務收費的金融業務恐受衝擊。
然而，能力落地受制於第三方平台。亞馬遜日前已阻止Muse進入其網站購物，稱Meta未獲授權；Shopify則選擇合作，允許Muse代客購買，這些都暴露AI代理商業化核心矛盾：技術上能訪問網站，不等於平台願意開放。若AI代理減少消費者直接瀏覽與點擊廣告次數，擁有龐大廣告業務的平台可能不願將入口讓給第三方代理。
最大風險仍在信任與競爭。根據Oppenheimer調查，僅8%美國消費者願將密碼交給Meta，而願信任谷歌的比例達30%。
此外，Meta正測試Muse「人工禮賓」功能，由人工承包商處理AI發起的部分電話，引發員工對敏感資訊外洩的擔憂。Meta表示該功能仍在測試，將建立安全與隱私機制後才推出。
華爾街預期OpenAI與谷歌將推出類似消費級AI代理，OpenAI內部已討論開發競品。一旦任務執行能力被快速複製，Muse先發優勢可能縮小。
商業化同樣未驗證：目前提供免費版及月費20與100美元方案，美銀分析師Justin Post認為廣告、訂閱與交易傭金在2028年前難成重大收入，Truist則預估到2030年Muse可能為Meta增加285億美元收入。
Muse已證明普通消費者願使用能真正採取行動的AI代理，而不只是聊天，但真正的「ChatGPT時刻」不能靠下載榜決定，Meta還需證明用戶會長期將郵件、日曆、購物與金融等高頻任務交給Muse，並持續授予足夠權限。兩週時間足以證明它不是無人問津的實驗，能否成為Meta進入下一代計算平台的入口，還要等新鮮感消退後，觀察使用習慣是否留存。
paras_en: Only two weeks after launch, Meta’s personal AI agent Muse has surged to the top of the free‑app chart on the U.S. Apple App Store, becoming a recent focus of both tech and capital markets. Sensor Tower data show that since its release on September 8, Muse has been downloaded more than 2.5 million times, and internal figures indicate that about a week after launch it had over 500,000 active users, more than 250,000 daily active users, and over 2 million commands submitted.

JPMorgan (referred to as “JPM”) released a research note on Tuesday the 22nd stating that Muse is showing strong early‑user growth and could become a key gateway for the company to turn AI investments from “ad efficiency” into new revenue streams beyond advertising. JPM believes that as consumers and enterprises gradually acquire their own AI agents, more shopping, booking and service transactions will be completed via “agent‑to‑agent” interactions, opening a new business model for Meta beyond ads. Accordingly, JPM reaffirmed its “overweight” rating on Meta and its $820 target price.

According to a report by The Information, buoyed by a wave of positive reviews for Muse, Meta’s stock jumped 11% on Monday the 21st – the biggest one‑day gain since April last year – and has risen nearly 30% so far in September. This AI application, launched in less than half a month, is simultaneously driving user growth, valuation expectations and multi‑industry competitive narratives, prompting observers to wonder whether this is a fleeting hype or truly Meta’s “ChatGPT moment.”

Muse’s core differentiator is shifting AI from merely “answering questions” to “doing things for you.” Users can command it to search and book travel, find deals, make phone calls, send emails, fill out web forms, organize inboxes and resolve scheduling conflicts. It can also connect to Gmail, Apple and Google calendars, OpenTable and other services, and leverage data from Facebook Marketplace, Instagram and other parts of the Meta ecosystem to perform personalized tasks.

Compared with the debut of ChatGPT at the end of 2022 that first let the public experience the value of generative AI, Muse is trying to achieve the next step: moving AI agents that were previously used mainly by developers into everyday consumer life, and early data support that possibility. Within a comparable launch window, Muse’s cumulative U.S. downloads at one point surpassed those of ChatGPT, Claude and Grok.

JPM analyst Doug Anmuth believes Muse has the potential to become one of the most widely used consumer‑grade AI applications after ChatGPT. Meta also enjoys advantages that independent AI startups cannot replicate: Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp together reach billions of users, and Muse is not only a standalone app but is also embedded in WhatsApp. The deeper the AI agent gets into email, calendars, contacts and consumption data, the higher its personalization value, and Meta already controls massive user‑relationship and content data.

Muse’s influence is already spilling beyond the AI sector. After collaborations with PayPal, Plaid and other firms, the S&P 500 financial group fell 2% on Tuesday the 22nd, with Charles Schwab and LPL Financial each dropping more than 6%, and large banks such as JPMorgan and Bank of America also seeing noticeable declines. The market worries that if AI agents can assist users around the clock in moving funds, managing idle cash, executing tax strategies and comparing financial products, parts of the financial‑service business that rely on customer inertia, idle capital and fee‑based human services could be disrupted.

However, the ability to deliver on that promise depends on third‑party platforms. Amazon recently blocked Muse from shopping on its site, saying Meta was not authorized; Shopify chose to cooperate, allowing Muse to make purchases on behalf of customers. These cases expose a core commercialization paradox for AI agents: technical access to a website does not guarantee the platform’s willingness to open it. If AI agents reduce the number of consumer page views and ad clicks, platforms that derive massive revenue from advertising may be reluctant to hand the entry point to third‑party agents.
The biggest risk remains trust and competition. An Oppenheimer survey found that only 8% of U.S. consumers would be willing to give their passwords to Meta, compared with 30% who would trust Google.

In addition, Meta is testing a “human concierge” feature for Muse, where human contractors handle certain calls initiated by the AI, raising employee concerns about the leakage of sensitive information. Meta says the feature is still in testing and will only be launched after security and privacy mechanisms are put in place.

Wall Street expects OpenAI and Google to roll out similar consumer‑grade AI agents, and OpenAI insiders have already discussed developing a competitor. If task‑execution capabilities are quickly replicated, Muse’s first‑mover advantage could shrink.

Commercialization is also unproven: Muse currently offers a free tier and paid plans at $20 and $100 per month. Bank of America analyst Justin Post believes that advertising, subscriptions and transaction commissions are unlikely to become material revenue sources before 2028, while Truist projects that Muse could add $28.5 billion of revenue to Meta by 2030.

Muse has shown that ordinary consumers are willing to use an AI agent that can actually take actions, not just chat, but the true “ChatGPT moment” cannot be decided by download rankings alone. Meta still needs to prove that users will consistently hand over high‑frequency tasks such as email, calendar, shopping and finance to Muse over the long term and grant it sufficient permissions. Two weeks are enough to show it isn’t a forgotten experiment; whether it becomes Meta’s gateway to the next‑generation computing platform will depend on whether usage habits persist after the novelty fades.

items.title: 美國9月企業活動創逾5年新高！需求強勁加劇通膨 Fed下月再升息押注升溫
items.title_en: U.S. September Business Activity Hits Over 5-Year High as Strong Demand Fuels Inflation, Fed Rate Hike Bets Heat Up
paras: 美國9月企業活動意外加速至逾5年來最強，製造業與服務業同步擴張，新訂單及就業顯著成長，顯示強勁內需、AI投資與國防支出持續支撐美國經濟。然而，需求暢旺也加劇供應鏈壅塞與通膨壓力，數據公布後，美國10年期公債殖利率升破5%，市場對聯準會(Fed)10月再次升息的預期隨之升高。
製造業、服務業同步升溫 經濟成長率上看5%
標普全球(S&P Global)周三(23日)公布，美國9月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)初值由8月的56.0升至58.4，不僅遠高於象徵景氣榮枯分界的50，也創2021年7月以來最高，連續第四個月加速擴張。標普全球表示，這項數據顯示美國經濟正以約5%的年率成長，第三季整體成長率可能達4%。
其中，服務業PMI由56.5升至58.7，高於市場預期的55.8，創59個月新高；製造業PMI則由53.9大幅躍升至57.0，同樣遠超預期的53.7，寫下52個月來最佳表現。
企業新訂單指數由55.2升至58.2，創2022年3月以來最高，製造業與服務業需求均明顯上升，主要動力來自國內市場。商品出口仍持續下滑，服務出口也僅溫和增長。
標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家威廉森(Chris Williamson)表示，美國製造業及服務業「顯然正蓬勃發展」。若排除疫情解封後的需求激增，本月企業活動改善幅度更是2015年初以來最大。
就業成長也達到逾4年來最快，服務業就業指標創2022年6月以來新高，製造業招聘力道則為2021年2月以來最強。強勁消費支出、AI帶動的企業投資及國防支出，均為企業活動提供支撐。
需求過熱推升成本 10年期公債殖利率突破5%
繁榮背後也浮現更多通膨風險。企業未完成訂單升至2022年5月以來最高，反映現有產能難以消化快速增加的需求；供應商交貨時間更出現2022年7月以來最普遍的延誤。威廉森指出，若排除疫情期間，目前供應鏈瓶頸已是這項調查進行近20年來最嚴重的水準之一。
美伊戰爭造成的能源及物流中斷，加上企業難以找到合適員工，進一步限制產能。雖然待處理訂單增加意味未來數月產出與產能仍有擴張空間，卻也代表企業取得更強的定價能力，對通膨前景構成威脅。
企業投入價格指數由8月的59.9猛升至66.4，創2022年10月以來最高。受訪企業主要歸咎於燃料、運輸與原物料成本攀升，部分業者也提到薪資壓力增加。尤其柴油價格升至歷史新高，未來可能進一步推高商品運輸成本及終端售價。
Fed上周才將基準利率升息1碼至3.75%至4.00%，並暗示未來數月可能繼續升息。這份遠超預期的PMI報告公布後，美國10年期公債殖利率再度突破5%，市場對10月升息的押注也隨之升溫。數據顯示，美國經濟雖展現強大韌性，但需求過熱與供應不足同時出現，恐使Fed抗通膨任務更加棘手。
paras_en: U.S. September business activity unexpectedly accelerated to the strongest level in more than five years, with manufacturing and services expanding together, and new orders and employment growing markedly, reflecting robust domestic demand, AI investment and defense spending that continue to support the U.S. economy. However, the surge in demand also worsened supply‑chain bottlenecks and inflationary pressure; after the data were released, the yield on the 10‑year Treasury rose above 5%, raising market expectations for another Fed rate hike in October.
Manufacturing and services both heating up, with growth rates projected around 5%

S&P Global reported on Wednesday (the 23rd) that the U.S. composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for September rose from 56.0 in August to 58.4, well above the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction and the highest since July 2021, marking the fourth consecutive month of accelerating expansion. S&P Global said the figure implies the U.S. economy is growing at roughly a 5% annual rate, with Q3 overall growth possibly reaching 4%.

The services PMI climbed from 56.5 to 58.7, beating the market forecast of 55.8 and hitting a 59‑month high; the manufacturing PMI jumped sharply from 53.9 to 57.0, also far above the expected 53.7, delivering the best performance in 52 months.

The new‑orders index rose from 55.2 to 58.2, the highest since March 2022, indicating clearly rising demand in both manufacturing and services, driven mainly by the domestic market. Goods exports continued to decline, while services exports grew only modestly.

Chris Williamson, chief commercial economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said U.S. manufacturing and services "are clearly booming." Excluding the post‑pandemic surge in demand, the improvement in business activity this month is the largest since early 2015.

Employment growth also hit the fastest pace in over four years, with the services employment indicator reaching its highest level since June 2022 and manufacturing hiring strength the strongest since February 2021. Strong consumer spending, AI‑driven corporate investment and defense spending all underpin the activity surge.
Overheating demand is pushing up costs, and the 10‑year Treasury yield has broken the 5% mark

Behind the boom, inflation risks are also rising. The backlog of unfilled orders rose to its highest level since May 2022, reflecting that existing capacity cannot absorb the rapid demand increase; supplier delivery times also showed the most widespread delays since July 2022. Williamson noted that, aside from the pandemic period, current supply‑chain bottlenecks are among the most severe observed in the nearly 20‑year history of the survey.

The war between the United States and Iran has caused energy and logistics disruptions, and firms are struggling to find suitable workers, further limiting capacity. While the growing order backlog suggests room for output and capacity expansion in the coming months, it also means firms have stronger pricing power, posing a threat to the inflation outlook.

The corporate input‑price index surged from 59.9 in August to 66.4, the highest since October 2022. Surveyed firms mainly blamed rising fuel, transportation and raw‑material costs, with some also citing increased wage pressures. Diesel prices, in particular, have hit historic highs and could further lift freight costs and end‑consumer prices.

The Fed last week raised its benchmark rate by one basis point to a range of 3.75%‑4.00% and signaled that further hikes may follow in the coming months. After the surprisingly strong PMI report was released, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield broke through 5% again, and market bets on an October rate hike warmed. The data show that while the U.S. economy displays strong resilience, overheating demand and insufficient supply are emerging together, potentially making the Fed’s anti‑inflation task even more challenging.

items.title: 貿聯9億美元併購案完成Interplex Datacom今起併表、AI資料中心營收規模再擴大
items.title_en: KY BizLink Completes $900 Million Acquisition; Interplex Datacom Consolidated, AI Data Center Revenue Scale Expands
paras: 2026年09月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 貿聯-KY BizLink(3665-TW)今日完成收購新加坡Interplex集團資料通訊業務Interplex Datacom，並自9月23日起正式納入合併報表。這筆交易不只是補強產品線，也讓貿聯一次取得資料中心互連技術、精密金屬加工能力及亞洲多地產能，進一步擴大AI資料中心基礎設施布局。
貿聯今年6月簽署收購協議，交易企業價值最高9億美元，其中8.5億美元為現金對價，另包含最高5,000萬美元或有對價，資金來源包括自有現金及花旗集團Citigroup(C-US)提供的承諾債務融資。
從收購規模來看，Interplex Datacom截至2026年3月31日止期間營收達3.92億美元。以最高9億美元企業價值計算，交易價格約為營收的2.3倍；若以8.5億美元現金對價計算，則約為2.2倍。隨9月23日起正式併表，Interplex Datacom也將開始對貿聯營收規模產生直接貢獻。
根據優分析統計，截至2026年9月，貿聯股價營收比已升至5.12倍，也來到歷史相對高檔。隨Interplex Datacom正式併表，市場關注焦點將從營收規模擴大，進一步轉向併購後能否提高AI資料中心業務占比與營收含金量。
更值得關注的是雙方產品與產能的互補性。Interplex Datacom總部位於新加坡，主要提供資料中心客製化互連及高精密機械產品，並在中國大陸、越南、馬來西亞及泰國設有生產據點，員工超過1,900人。
貿聯董事長梁華哲先前表示，Interplex Datacom可補強AI伺服器及機櫃Busbar(匯流排)等產品線，同時快速增加產能。透過整合雙方亞洲製造據點，貿聯可進一步擴充資料中心相關產品的供應能力與全球生產布局。

paras_en: September 23, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – KY BizLink (3665‑TW) completed today the acquisition of Interplex Group’s Singapore‑based data communications business Interplex Datacom and will begin consolidating it into its financial statements as of September 23. The deal not only strengthens its product line but also gives KY BizLink access to data‑center interconnect technology, precision metal‑working capabilities, and multiple production sites across Asia, further expanding its AI data‑center infrastructure footprint.

KY BizLink signed the acquisition agreement in June this year, with an enterprise value of up to US$900 million, of which US$850 million is cash consideration and up to US$50 million in contingent consideration. Funding comes from its own cash reserves and a committed debt facility from Citigroup (C‑US).

Based on the size of the acquisition, Interplex Datacom generated US$392 million in revenue for the period ending March 31, 2026. At the maximum US$900 million enterprise value, the purchase price is about 2.3 times revenue; using the US$850 million cash consideration, it is roughly 2.2 times revenue. With consolidation effective September 23, Interplex Datacom will begin to contribute directly to KY BizLink’s revenue.

According to U‑Analysis statistics, KY BizLink’s price‑to‑sales ratio had risen to 5.12 times by September 2026, reaching a historically high level. With Interplex Datacom now consolidated, market focus will shift from sheer revenue growth to whether the post‑M&A integration can raise the share and profitability of its AI data‑center business.

Equally noteworthy is the complementarity of the two companies’ products and capacities. Interplex Datacom is headquartered in Singapore, primarily offering customized data‑center interconnects and high‑precision mechanical products, and operates manufacturing sites in mainland China, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand with over 1,900 employees.

KY BizLink Chairman Liang Hua‑zhe previously said that Interplex Datacom can reinforce product lines such as AI servers and rack busbars, while quickly adding capacity. By integrating the two firms’ Asian manufacturing sites, KY BizLink can further expand its supply capability for data‑center‑related products and its global production footprint.
